# Orbucx

> DevOps and cloud consulting for startups and SMBs. Senior engineers only.

## What We Do

Orbucx is a boutique DevOps consultancy offering full-stack cloud engineering services:
- Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Pulumi)
- CI/CD pipeline setup and optimization
- Kubernetes consulting and migration
- Cloud cost optimization (FinOps)
- DevSecOps and compliance (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR)
- 24/7 incident response and managed operations

## Key Differentiators

- Every project staffed with senior engineers (12+ years experience)
- Free comprehensive cloud audit to start
- Fixed-price projects, no hourly surprises
- Retainers from $3,900/month (less than 1/3 of a full-time hire)

## Results

- 40% cloud cost reduction for a scaling SaaS startup (AWS)
- 11-minute zero-downtime Kubernetes migration for a fintech
- Zero critical findings after security overhaul for e-commerce company
